blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multi-agent large language model (LLM) debate is often evaluated by whether final answers improve, but
movement is not necessarily improvement: the same discussion can rescue an
initially wrong majority or destroy an initially correct one. Standard
final-accuracy evaluations conflate these opposing mechanisms. We introduce an
auditable protocol for homogeneous debate on multiple-choice questions (MCQs)
that records each run as a
transition ledger over collapse, correction, onset, and signed intervention
utility. On 6,925 6{,}925 MMLU-Pro debates, the protocol identifies 253 253 collapses
and a parallel correction ledger that changes how interventions should be
judged. Replay experiments reveal the central tradeoff: a leave-one-model-out
probe-gated freeze prevents 29 29 collapses but loses 108 108 corrections under
equal weights, so collapse prevention alone can recommend the wrong
policy. A compact pre-debate 8 8 -probe screen is a triage signal: its
unadjusted family-level association with conditional-collapse risk is high
( G = 7 G{=}7 , Spearman ρ = 0.893 \rho=0.893 , exact two-sided p = 0.0123 p=0.0123 ), but
initial-majority accuracy is a close comparator ( ρ = 0.821 \rho=0.821 ; family partial ρ = 0.767 \rho=0.767 , p = 0.0877 p=0.0877 ), so we do not treat it as calibrated or
capability-adjusted prediction. Round-level traces localize many collapses
to the first debate round, where early disagreement can precede both
harmful cascades and useful recovery. We release replayable schemas, coders,
audits, cost cards, and zero-API rebuild scripts so future model–scaffold rows
can be compared under the same denominators and signed utility ledger.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-agent large language model (LLM) debate is often treated as a repair mechanism: let models
expose one another’s mistakes before a final answer is chosen [ 7 , 12 ] . But revision has two directions. The
same discussion that can correct an initially wrong majority can also collapse an initially correct majority into a wrong consensus, without an
external adversary, tool output, or new evidence. Debate gains depend on
diversity and confidence [ 13 , 32 ] , while
sycophancy and conformity provide routes for mistaken answers to spread [ 11 ] . We study a deliberately narrow
setting: homogeneous, closed-book, three-agent LLM debate on
multiple-choice (MCQ) tasks. Even in
this setting, we observe 253 253 collapses across 6,925 6{,}925 MMLU-Pro debates [ 25 ] ; for
the most susceptible models, more than one in ten initially correct majorities
are lost.

Figure 1 summarizes the transition-accounting view. The need for
transition accounting appears before any new policy is proposed.
Sonnet 4.5 and Llama- 3.1 3.1 - 8 8 B have nearly identical debate flip rates
( 0.705 0.705 vs. 0.726 0.726 ), yet Llama’s conditional collapse rate is about four times higher
( 8.46 % 8.46\% vs. 2.15 % 2.15\% ). The missing variable is direction, not motion. We
therefore evaluate the 2 × 2 2{\times}2 ledger formed by initial-majority

when a correct majority first breaks, and what a proposed intervention would

To decide where richer trace logging is worth the cost, we use a compact
pre-debate compliance screen before running the debate sweep. Each MCQ item is
re-asked under an 8 8 -probe argument/social battery, and α tot \alpha_{\text{tot}} records the total answer-change rate. On the realized MMLU-Pro cohort, this

confirmatory, so we treat the screen as a protocol-bound triage measurement: a
way to prioritize model–scaffold rows for audit, not a calibrated per-question
oracle or a capability-free model property.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-agent debate and collapse. Multi-agent debate has been used for LLM reasoning, evaluation, and oversight [ 7 , 12 , 13 , 3 , 5 , 29 ] . Recent work turns from average gains to when debate helps, fails, or should be skipped: uncertainty-driven mitigation [ 22 ] , homogeneity and confidence/diversity limits [ 32 ] , peer sycophancy [ 11 ] , and adaptive debate or stability failures [ 28 , 21 , 9 , 27 ] . We contribute a transition-table evaluation: when debate destroys an initially correct majority, when it rescues an initially wrong one, and how interventions trade the two.
blocks.zh: 多代理辩论与崩溃. 多代理辩论被用于LLM推理,评价和监督[7,12,13,3,5,29]. 近期的工作从平均收益转向辩论有帮助、有失败或应当失败时:不确定性驱动的缓解[22]、同质性和信心/多样性的限度[32]、同行的和谐[11]、以及适应性辩论或稳定性的失败[28、21、9、27]。 我们提供了过渡性评价:当辩论破坏最初正确的多数时,当辩论挽救最初错误的多数时,以及干预如何交易两者时。

blocks.en: Sycophancy, conformity, and compliance. Instruction-tuned LLMs can echo users, follow misleading cues, over-agree with majorities, or rationalize biased answers [ 16 , 20 , 26 , 24 ] ; related work separates informational from normative pressure and studies sycophancy circuits [ 31 , 15 ] . We use this literature as measurement substrate, not as a novelty claim about revisability: our 4 × 2 4{\times}2 argument/social factorial is a behavioral screen, and our artifacts contain probes and debate traces rather than activation-cache circuit scores.
blocks.zh: 交际,符合,和遵守。 指令调制的LLMS可以回响用户,遵循误导提示,过份同意多数,或者合理解释有偏见的答案[16,20,26,24];相关工作将信息与规范压力和研究杂化电路[31,15]分开. 我们使用这些文献作为测量底物,而不是对可重视性的一种新奇说法: 我们的4×2 4×times}2 论点/社会因素是一个行为屏幕,我们的文物包含探针和辩论痕迹,而不是激活-缓存电路分数.

blocks.en: Scalable oversight and aggregation. Scalable-oversight theory studies capability gaps and divergent knowledge [ 8 , 30 ] , while aggregation work proposes confidence weighting, early stopping, sequential voting, and debate controllers [ 23 , 19 , 1 , 10 ] ; opinion-dynamics models supply cascade intuitions [ 2 , 6 , 17 ] . Our homogeneous traces cannot forecast heterogeneous overseer/worker gaps. Instead, α tot \alpha_{\text{tot}} is a pre-debate risk measurement, Round 1 1 features are runtime diagnostics, and replay scores signed utility after counting both collapses prevented and corrections lost.
blocks.zh: 可扩展的监督和汇总。 可缩放监督理论研究能力差距和不同知识[8,30],而汇总工作则提出信心权重,早期停止,顺序投票,辩论控制器[23,19,1,10];舆论动力学模型提供级联直觉[2,6,17]. 我们的同质痕迹无法预测不同的监督员/工人的差距。 相反,α tot\ alpha_{\text{tot}} 是一个辩论前的风险度量,第1轮的特性是运行时间诊断,在计算既防止倒塌又失去修正后重播签名的功用.

blocks.en: Unlike work that proposes a new debate scaffold, mitigation method, or aggregation rule, we do not claim a deployable debate system. We provide an evaluation target, the transition table and signed replay ledger, against which such systems can be rescored. The negative intervention rows are therefore calibration baselines for the ledger, not competing controllers.
blocks.zh: 与提出新的辩论脚手架、缓解方法或汇总规则的工作不同,我们不主张可部署的辩论制度。 我们提供了一个评价目标、过渡表和经签名的重播分类账,可据此重新记分这些系统。 因此,负干预行是分类账的校准基线,而不是相互竞争的控制器.

The MCQ parser prefers explicit “Final Answer: X”, answer/choose variants, standalone option letters, then a last-valid-letter fallback. Capability pressure ranks Qwen3-4B above Llama- 3.1 3.1 - 8 8 B in risk because their initial-majority accuracies are 45.3 % 45.3\% and 50.7 % 50.7\% , respectively. This is the intended use case: allocating trace evaluation to risky model–scaffold rows, not predicting per-question collapse or directly controlling debate. blocks.en: The cross-benchmark rows do not enter the MMLU-Pro family statistic, and they do not establish benchmark-general screen transfer. Their role is narrower: they test whether final accuracy still hides opposing collapse and correction flows outside the primary benchmark. On GPQA, Mistral Small 4 is nearly accuracy-neutral because collapses and corrections almost cancel, while DeepSeek V4 Flash gains despite nonzero collapse because corrections dominate ( Tables 2 and 30 ). In the Mistral row, four questions lack a valid initial majority; excluding them changes the signed net from + 1 +1 to − 1 -1 ( Section G.3 ). The Llama and DeepSeek per-question α \alpha –collapse associations are near zero, so these rows support transition accounting rather than screen transfer ( Section D.3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Trace Localization: Where Collapse Appears in Debate
blocks.zh: 5 追踪本地化 : 辩论中出现的折叠

blocks.en: Most tracked collapses begin early, but early warning is not the same as safe control. The family-level result in Section 4 is a selection-time triage signal; once debate begins, Round 1 1 trajectory features expose risk more directly. This section therefore treats trace features as diagnostic localization, not causal mediation, and sets up the signed replay test in Section 6 .

blocks.en: The probe channels are not just a single generic compliance axis. Anti-argument and anti-social system prompts elicit measurably different flip distributions in all 16 / 16 16/16 tested models, with grand mean Cohen’s d = 0.53 d{=}0.53 and 12 / 16 12/16 paired tests surviving Holm–Bonferroni correction ( Figures 3 and 20 ). The effect is not uniform: Qwen3-4B ( d = 0.092 d{=}0.092 ) and Qwen3-8B ( d = 0.057 d{=}0.057 ) are near-zero separability cases. The main prompt-factor confound is the strongest corrective variant, which includes an authority-style answer cue. In the raw-log subset, removing that very_strong probe preserves the model-level S/A ordering exactly (Spearman ρ = 1.00 \rho{=}1.00 over four models) and changes matched collapse-prediction AUC by at most 0.004 0.004 ; a non-social-only control changes AUC by at most 0.005 0.005 ( Sections B.5 and C.6 ).

blocks.en: These checks do not prove perfect factorization, but they rule out the simplest authority-cue-only explanation. Because Qwen is also the largest dependence cluster in the MMLU-Pro cohort, we do not interpret the α tot \alpha_{\text{tot}} association as evidence that argument and social channels factor cleanly inside that family. The screen is an aggregate revisability readout; the α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} channel is therefore best read as a repeatable behavioral diagnostic of adversarial revisability, not as a new sycophancy construct by itself. Additional OpenRouter channel lanes preserve the same ordering but remain diagnostic rather than primary evidence ( Section B.8 ).

blocks.en: Post-hoc follow-up: private revision and reasoning modes. To address whether debate among copies could be replaced by self-revision or reasoning, a follow-up branches every arm from the same saved Round- 0 0 answers and codes ties as undecided ( Section G.5 ). Across 12 12 repeated MCQ settings, private revision (the debate prompt with only the agent’s own previous response) is 1.44 1.44 – 4.81 4.81 points less accurate than peer debate when ties count as wrong; it reduces wrong-answer collapses but leaves more ties, and crediting ties at their expected value narrows the difference to between − 1.62 -1.62 and + 0.38 +0.38 points. In eleven reasoning-mode rows, collapses and corrections both persist, and private revision has a negative point difference in all eleven (intervals below zero in seven; Table 8 ). These results bound, rather than settle, the comparison with compute-matched solo reasoning.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The primary association uses the realized matched cohort ( N = 14 N{=}14 rows, G = 7 G{=}7 families), not the pre-registered N = 18 N{=}18 . It is small and uneven; exact family tests are primary, with model-row results as sensitivity and leave-one-family, taxonomy, measurement-error, and parser checks bounding rather than removing this limit ( Sections C.2 , C.6 and A.3.3 ). Held-out-family diagnostics test rank discipline, not calibrated forecasting. Scope is narrow: homogeneous same-model, closed-book MCQ debate. MMLU-Pro is primary; ARC, TruthfulQA, GPQA, and OpenRouter/Gemini rows do not establish benchmark transfer or cover heterogeneous judge–debater systems, tool use, retrieval, free-form generation, rubric- or judge-scored answers, or agent workflows that gather evidence over longer contexts rather than static choices. Mixed-model panels and GSM8K rows added after review are feasibility checks, not transfer evidence ( Section G.3 ).
blocks.zh: 主要协会使用已实现匹配的组群(N=14N{=}14行,G=7G{=}7户),而非预先注册的N=18N{=}18. 它规模小,而且不均衡;精确的家庭测试是初级的,模型-排行结果为敏感性和休假-一个家庭、分类学、计量-误差和剖析检查,而不是取消这一限制(C.2、C.6和A.3.3节)。 闲置家庭诊断测试分级学科,不校准预测. 范围狭义:同型同型,封闭式的MCQ辩论. MMLU-Pro为主; ARC, TruthfulQA, GPQA, 和OpenRouter/Gemini行不建立基准转移或覆盖不同的裁判员系统, 工具使用,检索, 自由形式生成, rumric- 或判断员分数的答案, 或代理工作流程, 通过较长的背景而不是静态的选择收集证据. 经审查后增加的混合型面板和GSM8K行是可行性检查,而不是转移证据(G.3节)。

blocks.en: The screen is protocol-bound triage, not a capability-free property, per-question oracle, or controller. Initial-majority accuracy is a close comparator; after Round 0 0 sampling, disagreement is the stronger runtime diagnostic. Round 1 1 trajectories localize risk without causal mediation; controllers need correction-preserving uncertainty, prespecified weights, and held-out signed replay.
blocks.zh: 屏幕是受协议约束的分解,而非无能力属性,每问题甲骨文,或控制器. 初始多数精度是接近的参照;第0轮采样后,分歧是更强的运行时间诊断. 第1轮1轨迹在不因果调解的情况下将风险定位;控制器需要修正-保留不确定性,预设权重,并挂号重播.

blocks.en: Reasoning models. The primary cohort does not isolate reasoning mode or effort, and one of its rows (DeepSeek V4 Flash) ran with provider reasoning enabled. A follow-up with shared initial answers finds collapses and corrections in every reasoning-mode row, including gpt-oss-20b at two effort levels, and finds private revision less accurate than peer debate when ties count as wrong ( Sections G.4 and G.5 ). It does not establish that debate outperforms a compute-matched solo reasoning baseline.
blocks.zh: 理由模型。 主组不孤立推理模式或努力,它的一行(DeepSeek V4 Flash)运行时启用了提供者推理. 用共同的初始答案进行后续发现每个推理-模式行的崩溃和纠正,包括两个努力级的gpt-oss-20b,发现在关系算错时,私译比同行辩论更准确(G.4和G.5节). 它没有确定辩论的表现超过一个计算得当的独奏推理基线。

blocks.en: Artifact boundary. The released artifact ( https://lixin.ai/DebateLedger ) rebuilds transition, parser, cost, metadata, and signed-replay summaries without API calls; safety-sensitive prompts and transcripts are release-tiered, and Section G.6 separates zero-API rebuilds, aggregate-only results, provider-dependent reruns, and gated fields. Exact per-debate Round 1 1 and strict matched- τ \tau DisagreementGate matrices remain gated, so those results are diagnostic rather than primary and provider reruns may drift.
blocks.zh: 艺术界. 发行的文物(https://lixin.ai/DebateLedger)重建了过渡,解析,成本,元数据,以及未经API调用的签名-重播摘要;安全敏感提示和笔录是发布-分级的,而G.6节将零-API重建,集成-只收结果,依赖提供者的重播,以及闸门字段分开. 精确的每回合1, 严格匹配的 \ tau DispoliticGate 矩阵仍然被锁定, 因此这些结果是诊断性的, 而不是初级和提供者的重运行 。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Debate evaluation should report signed transition utility rather than final accuracy alone. Our protocol combines transition tables, conditional collapse, correction, onset, and signed replay so another lab can add a model–scaffold row and compare ( prevented , lost , net ) (\mathrm{prevented},\mathrm{lost},\mathrm{net}) cells under declared weights. The practical implication is that a controller’s denominator, action rule, and saved collapses should be shown beside the useful corrections it discards. A scaffold is safer only when harmful cascades fall without erasing recoveries; future debate, judge–debater, abstention, or deferral systems can be compared on these transition cells instead of incompatible headline accuracies. The ledger keeps that comparison auditable when user-stated utility weights change which controller is selected.
blocks.zh: 辩论评价应报告已签署的过渡效用,而不是仅报告最后准确性。 我们的协议结合了过渡表,有条件的崩溃,校正,发端,并签名的重放,这样另一个实验室就可以在声明的重量下添加一个模型 - 脚手列和比较(防止,丢失,网) (\mathrm{ prevented},\mathrm{lost},\mathrm{net}) 单元格 。 实际含义是,控制器的分母、动作规则和节省下来的崩溃应该在其丢弃的有益修正之外显示。 只有当有害的级联倒塌而不消除回收时,脚手架才会更安全;未来的辩论、法官辩论、弃权或推迟系统可以比较这些过渡细胞,而不是不兼容的头条急迫。 当用户申报的效用权重改变选择哪个控制器时,分类账保持该比较可审计。

blocks.en: A.3.1 Realized-Cohort Statistical Audit

blocks.en: Pre-registration chronology and realized-cohort correction. The April 19 pre-registration locked an N = 18 N{=}18 model-row Spearman extension as the confirmatory analysis. That exact target was not realized: attrition and manifest-discipline exclusions reduced the matched post-A6 cohort to N = 14 N{=}14 , and six of those rows are related Qwen variants. We therefore report the family-aggregated exact test as a design-aware non-independence correction for the realized cohort, while preserving the N = 14 N{=}14 model-row Spearman, sealed N = 9 N{=}9 vintage, taxonomy sweeps, and leave-one-family checks as sensitivity views. This is a realized-cohort correction to the inferential unit, not a claim that the originally targeted N = 18 N{=}18 model-row primary was completed unchanged.
blocks.zh: 登记前编年表与实现校正. 4月19日的预注册将一个N=18 NQQ18型号的Spearman扩展锁定为确认分析. 这一确切目标没有实现:减员和明令纪律排除将对应的A6后组减为N=14N{=}14,其中6行是相关的Quen变体。 因此,我们将家庭分类精确测试报告为对已实现群体进行设计意识不独立的校正,同时保留N=14 N{=}14型模组Spearman,封存N=9 N{=}9型,分类学扫描,以及离开一个家庭检查作为敏感性观点。 这是对引证单位的实测校正,而不是声称原目标N = 18 N = 18 型号一排初级完成不变。

It recomputes the family-level exact permutation test, N14 errors-in-variables bootstrap, capability/revision partial correlations, Wilson/Jeffreys conditional-collapse intervals, parser-failure counts, parse-missing sensitivity, and file provenance. The companion analysis script reads existing traces only and does not call external APIs. A separate parser cell-stability script writes both Markdown and machine-readable parser-audit outputs.

blocks.en: A.4 Ethics and Dual-Use Statement
blocks.zh: A.4 道德操守和双重用途说明

blocks.en: This section follows the NeurIPS 2026 ethics-statement guidelines and addresses the dual-use surface of releasing a calibration instrument that, by construction, characterizes prompt patterns more likely to flip a correct answer to a wrong one.
blocks.zh: 本节遵循了NeurIPS 2026道德申报准则,并讨论了释放一种校准仪器的双重用途表面问题,通过构建,这种仪器具有迅速模式的特征,更有可能将正确的答案翻到错误的答案上。

blocks.en: Dual-use surface of the convince-wrong probe class. The 8-probe instrument crosses four argument strengths (weak / moderate / strong / very-strong) with two social levels, and four of the eight probes are explicitly counter-correct (“convince-wrong”). α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} measures the rate at which a model abandons a correct initial answer under such counter-arguments, and ranking models on α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} alone could be misread as a leaderboard of which models are easiest to mislead. We frame α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} as a calibration diagnostic paired with α cor \alpha_{\text{cor}} and report both jointly throughout: a model that is hard to flip but also hard to correct is not safer in deployment, only more rigid. We discourage citing per-model α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} as a stand-alone safety metric or in marketing comparisons, and the dataset card includes a usage note to that effect.
blocks.zh: 双用途表面 令人信服的错误探测器类。 8. 探测仪器跨越了两个社会层面的四个参数优势(弱/中/强/强),8个探测器中有4个明显反正(“说服-错误”). α adv\ alpha\ text{adv} 测量一个模型在这样的反证下放弃正确的初始答案的速度,单在 α adv\ alpha\ text{adv\} 上的排名模型可能会被误读为领导牌, 其中模型最容易误导. 我们把 α adv\ alpha\ text{adv} 设定为 α corpha\\ text{cor} 的校准诊断 , 并共同报告整个过程: 一个很难翻转但又难以纠正的模型在部署中并不安全, 我们劝阻人们不把promodel α adv\ alpha\\text{adv}作为一个独立的安全指标,

blocks.en: Gated artifact release. The artifact release plan covers the probe set, response traces, evaluation code, and the multi-round debate transcripts under the underlying-benchmark licenses (MMLU-Pro [ 25 ] , ARC-Challenge [ 4 ] , GPQA [ 18 ] , and TruthfulQA [ 14 ] ). To limit casual reuse as an attack corpus, the convince-wrong probe templates and tuned phrasings are released under a gated artifact host (gated repository plus click-through use restriction limiting redistribution and prohibiting use to fine-tune models that target real users without independent safety review). Aggregate α \alpha statistics, the non-social weak/moderate/strong subset, and the full code are released without gating to support open replication. Gated requests are adjudicated by an artifact steward using the same research-use criteria stated in the release card; the card records the requested identity/affiliation, intended use, redistribution commitment, and upstream benchmark-license acknowledgement. The target response time is ten business days; denials include a short reason and a resubmission path after scope or license issues are corrected. We do not release tuned attack scaffolds, multi-turn jailbreak chains, or evasion variants beyond the eight probe templates documented in the paper.
blocks.zh: 古董发布. 文物释放计划包括探测器集、反应痕迹、评价代码以及基础基准许可下的多轮辩论记录(MMLU-Pro [25]、ARC-Challenge [4]、GPQA [18]和TrealfulQA [14])。 为了限制作为攻击体的随机重复使用,在有门的文物主机下发布了令人信服-错误的探测模板和调制词(gated propose + 点击式使用限制限制限制再分配,并禁止使用微调模式,在没有独立安全审查的情况下针对真实用户). 集合α\alpha统计,非社会弱/中/强子集,完整代码发布时不支持公开复制. 申请由文物管理员使用发行卡上所述的同样的研究使用标准裁定;该卡记录所要求的身份/附属关系、预期用途、再分配承诺和上游基准许可确认。 目标答复时间为10个工作日;拒绝答复包括一个短的理由和在范围或许可证问题得到纠正后重新提交的途径。 我们不会放出调谐攻击脚手架,多回合越狱链, 或逃逸变体 超出论文记录的8个探测模板。

blocks.en: Mitigations and red-team probes already run. Beyond the headline analysis, we ran three internal red-team checks before deciding to release: (i) prompt-injection robustness of the probe template itself (whether an adversarial probe can bypass the eval scaffold and cause inflated α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} – no false-positive inflation observed at n = 50 n{=}50 adversarial trials); (ii) authority-cue leakage in the very-strong probe ( Section C.6 R2: dropping the probe strengthens the headline correlation rather than removing it, indicating the result is not driven by an authority shortcut); (iii) a content-safety review of the convince-wrong probe text by an external safety auditor, confirming none of the eight templates includes harmful content beyond plausible-sounding incorrect arguments on benchmark questions. Safety-audit notes are archived with the dataset with identifying details redacted.
blocks.zh: 缓解和红队探测器已经运行。 在标题分析之外,我们在决定发布前进行了三次内部红队检查:(一) 探测器模板本身的迅速注入强度(对抗性探测器是否可以绕过电子脚手架并引起夸大α adv\ alpha\\\ text{adv} — 在n=50 n\\50 对抗性试验时没有观察到虚假的阳性通货膨胀);(二) 极强探测器中的权威渗漏(C.6 R2节): 探测器的掉落加强了头条的关联性,而不是去除它,表明结果不是由当局的捷径驱动的);(三) 外部安全审计员对令人信服的探测器文本进行内容安全审查,确认8个模板中没有一个包含有害内容,而不是对基准问题提出可信的不正确论点。 安全审计笔记与数据集一起存档,并编辑识别细节。

blocks.en: Scope of human-subjects and personal data. The work uses only public benchmark questions; no human-subjects data, personally identifying information, or crowd-worker labels were collected, so IRB review was not required. Compute consumption (8 OSS models served on local A6000 48GB GPUs plus closed-API requests) is reported in the reproducibility section.
blocks.zh: 人文主题和个人资料的范围. 作品仅使用公共基准问题;没有收集人主体数据,个人识别信息,也没有收集人群-工人标签,因此不需要IRB审查. 计算消耗(8个开放源码软件模型服务于当地A6000 48GB GPU+闭合API请求)在可复制部分中报告.

blocks.en: Residual risk. The remaining risk surface mirrors that of recent sycophancy, conformity, and debate-failure audits [ 28 , 21 , 11 ] : even with gated release, a determined adversary can reconstruct similar probe sets. Our position is that the calibration value of a transparent, pre-registered instrument outweighs the marginal uplift to attackers, and we welcome critique of that judgement during review.
blocks.zh: 残余风险。 剩下的风险表面镜像是最近发生的杂乱无章、一致性和辩论失败审计[28、21、11]:即使有门释放,确定的对手也可以重建类似的探测装置。 我们的立场是,透明、预先登记的仪器的校准价值超过了攻击者略微提高的价值,我们欢迎在审查期间对这一判断提出批评。

blocks.en: B.1 High-FR Question Pool: Selection and Sensitivity
blocks.zh: B.1 高强度问题库:选择和敏感性

blocks.en: Selection procedure. The 200 high-FR questions used to estimate S/A in Table 16 are picked per model as follows. (1) Run the 8-probe battery on a fixed 1,000-question MMLU-Pro pool. (2) Score each question by the model’s mean solo flip rate (the four non-social probes only; this avoids bleed from the social manipulation we are trying to measure). (3) Keep the top 200 questions by solo FR. The selection is computed entirely on probe behavior, never on debate outcomes (collapse, correction, or any downstream label), so it is outcome-blind with respect to the targets reported in Table 16 . Selected items may later be debated as part of the model-row audit, but no item is selected, dropped, or reweighted using its debate transition label. Because the rank is computed per model, two different models in general get different question sets; for the same model, the procedure is deterministic given the random probe seed.
blocks.zh: 甄选程序。 表16中用于估算S/A的200个高富含氟度问题按以下模式选择。 (1)在固定的1000问题MMLU-Pro游泳池上运行8-探测电池. (2) 每个问题按模型的平均独翻率计分(仅四个非社会探测器;这可以避免我们试图衡量的社会操纵造成的流血)。 (3)通过独唱FR保持前200题. 选择完全根据探险行为计算,从不考虑辩论结果(碰撞、修正或任何下游标签),因此,对于表16中报告的目标来说,选择完全没有结果。 选定项目以后可能作为示范项目审计的一部分进行辩论,但没有使用辩论过渡标签选择、放弃或重新加权项目。 因为排名是每个模型计算出来的,一般有两种不同的模型得到不同的问题集;对于同一个模型,考虑到随机探测种子,程序是决定性的.

blocks.en: Sensitivity to selection. To rule out that S/A rankings are an artifact of the per-model selection, we recomputed S/A on a single shared 200-question pool defined as the intersection of the four model-specific top-200 pools that overlap most. The model-level rank ordering of S/A is unchanged (Spearman ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 between the per-model and shared-pool rankings on the four overlap models), and the largest absolute shift in S/A is 0.04 0.04 . We also recomputed S/A on the full 1,000-question pool (no high-FR restriction): all 16 S/A point estimates fall inside their per-model bootstrap 95% CI from Table 17 . We therefore treat the per-model high-FR pool as a power-tightening choice that does not redirect cross-model comparisons.

blocks.zh: B.2 S/A 诱饵信任间隔

blocks.en: Table 17 quantifies uncertainty in the descriptive S/A statistic used for the high-FR probe pool checks. Each interval resamples question-level S/A estimates within a model; it is therefore a within-row measurement interval, not a cross-model hypothesis test. Positive intervals indicate rows where the social-over-argument balance is reliably above zero under the default high-FR pool, while intervals crossing zero mark rows where the channel-balance sign should not be over-interpreted. These intervals support the selection-sensitivity statement in Section B.1 : full-pool S/A estimates stay within the bootstrap ranges, so the high-FR restriction sharpens measurement without changing the qualitative pool-check conclusion.

blocks.en: B.5 Probe-Control Robustness
blocks.zh: B.5 探测控制能力

blocks.en: To check whether our main probe-based conclusions depend on the strongest prompt variant or on the current social wording, we re-analyzed stored raw probe outputs under two controls: (i) removing the very_strong probe and (ii) using only the four non-social probes. We had raw probe logs for four models (Haiku, Sonnet, Gemini 2.5-Flash, GPT-4o-mini). Removing very_strong preserved the model-level S/A ordering exactly (Spearman ρ = 1.00 \rho=1.00 across the four models), with the largest absolute shift in mean S/A only 0.024. At the question level, the maximum probe flip rate remained highly correlated with the full 8-probe estimate (minimum r = 0.961 r=0.961 without very_strong ; minimum r = 0.896 r=0.896 for non-social-only).
blocks.zh: 为了检查我们基于探测器的主要结论是取决于最强的即时变体还是当前社会措辞,我们在两个控制下重新分析存储的原始探测器输出:(一)移除非常强的探测器和(二)只使用四个非社会探测器. 我们有四个模型的原始探测日志(海库、松网、双子座2.5-Flash、GPT-4o-mini)。 删除非常强烈地保留了模型级 S/A 精确的顺序(Spearman à = 1.00\rho = 1.00),平均 S/A 中最大的绝对值只有 0.024 。 在问题层面,最大探测器翻转率与全部8-probe估计值(最低r=0.961 r=0.961而不非常强烈;最低r=0.896 r=0.896不只针对社会)仍然高度相关.

blocks.en: We also recomputed collapse prediction on the three models with matched debate traces (Haiku, Gemini, GPT-4o-mini). The combined predictor used in the main text (mean probe flip rate + difficulty + initial disagreement) changed by at most 0.004 AUC when very_strong was removed and by at most 0.005 AUC when only non-social probes were used. Thus, while these controls do not prove that the prompt factors are perfectly orthogonal, they indicate that the main predictor ordering is robust to both prompt simplifications.
blocks.zh: 我们还对三种模型(海库、双子座、GPT-4o-mini)的崩溃预测进行了重新计算。 正文中使用的综合预测器(平均探针翻转率+难度+初始分歧)在极强的AUC被移除时变化最多0.004 AUC,在仅使用非社会探测器时变化最多0.005 AUC. 因此,虽然这些控制不能证明即时因子是完全正统的,但是它们表明,主要预测器的顺序对两种即时简化都是有力的。

blocks.en: B.7 Family-Level Channel Patterns
blocks.zh: B.7 家庭渠道模式

blocks.en: The 16-model manipulation reveals consistent behavioral differences across families. OpenAI models show the strongest channel manipulation effects (mean d = 0.82 d=0.82 ) with prominent channel substitution. Open-source models span a wide range: Llama-3.1-8B shows the largest individual effect ( d = 2.39 d=2.39 ) while Qwen models show the weakest ( d = 0.06 d=0.06 – 0.09 0.09 ), suggesting that channel separability varies with both model family and instruction-tuning approach. Anthropic models show weaker but selective effects (mean d = 0.21 d=0.21 ), while Google models fall between (mean d = 0.31 d=0.31 ). We emphasize that these are functional descriptions of observed behavior under our probing protocol, not claims about internal model architectures or specific training procedures. Establishing causal links to training choices would require controlled ablations with access to the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 16模式的操控揭示了不同家庭之间持续的行为差异. OpenAI模型显示最强的信道操纵效果(平均d = 0.82 d = 0.82),显著的信道替代. 开源模型跨度很广:Llama-31-8B显示最大的个体效应(d = 2.39 d = 2.39),而Quen模型显示最弱者(d = 0.06 d = 0.06 – 0.09 0.09),说明信道的分离性随模型家族和指令调制方法都有所不同. Anthropic模型显示弱但选择性效果(平均d=0.21 d=0.21),而Google模型则介于(平均d=0.31 d=0.31)之间. 我们强调,这些是对我们探测协议下观察到的行为的功能描述,而不是对内部模型架构或具体训练程序的声称. 建立与培训选择的因果联系,需要有控制地使用培训管道。

blocks.en: Main-text Table 4 reports zero-API diagnostics on the same realized N = 14 N{=}14 cohort as Table 23 . This is a confound and comparator check, not a new primary test. Only the screen and initial-majority accuracy are pre-debate quantities; final accuracy, correction rate, and raw collapse rate are post-debate or outcome-derived controls included to quantify confounding pressure. Initial accuracy is a strong capability proxy and is itself anti-correlated with collapse; its sign-flipped version, 1 − init-acc 1{-}\text{init-acc} , is our closest local Engels-style capability-pressure proxy. α tot \alpha_{\mathrm{tot}} remains associated with C cond C^{\mathrm{cond}} under simple rank residualizations: controlling the capability-pressure proxy gives ρ = + 0.658 \rho{=}{+}0.658 ( p = 0.014 p{=}0.014 ); controlling raw debate-revision proxy alone gives ρ = + 0.780 \rho{=}{+}0.780 ( p = 0.0017 p{=}0.0017 ); controlling capability pressure plus the raw debate-revision proxy gives ρ = + 0.667 \rho{=}{+}0.667 ( p = 0.018 p{=}0.018 ). A Sharma/Perez-style social-pressure flip-rate proxy, defined as mean flip rate on social-attributed counterarguments, is highly collinear with α tot \alpha_{\mathrm{tot}} ( ρ = + 0.873 \rho{=}{+}0.873 model-row and + 0.893 +0.893 family-level against C cond C^{\mathrm{cond}} ) because it is a one-sided slice of the same flip-rate battery. We therefore do not treat it as an independent social mechanism score; the narrower social-over-solo lift is the cleaner conformity contrast, and it is not predictive. We do not claim a Pandey-circuit replication: the checked-in artifacts contain behavioral probes and debate traces, not activation-cache circuit scores. Exact Engels capability-gap forecasts would likewise require heterogeneous overseer/worker capability panels rather than homogeneous three-agent traces.

blocks.en: After the sealed headline cohort was fixed, we also ran five API lanes with both the same D/AS/AA probe and matched four-round debate traces on the same high-FR MMLU-Pro protocol. We therefore do not refit the N = 14 N{=}14 scatter, recompute the primary Spearman statistic, or use these rows to update Table 23 . The value of the panel is narrower: it checks whether additional API endpoints expose obvious counterexamples or boundary conditions under strict question overlap.

blocks.en: To find denser non-MMLU stress tests, we expanded OpenRouter GPQA lanes to the full 198 198 -question GPQA Diamond split. These runs are post-hoc and excluded from every MMLU-Pro headline statistic, but they are useful because they populate both sides of the transition table. Mistral Small 4 has 20 / 120 20/120 conditional collapses and 21 / 78 21/78 corrections, producing only + 1 +1 net debate under equal collapse/correction weights. Llama 3.3 70B and DeepSeek V4 Flash add a useful contrast: both have measurable collapses, but standard debate is net positive because corrections are larger ( + 7 +7 and + 37 +37 debates, respectively). Four Mistral questions have no valid initial majority and are counted as initially wrong; excluding them changes the Mistral net from + 1 +1 to − 1 -1 ( Section G.3 ). blocks.en: We additionally reran Qwen3-32B as a fresh post-hoc local-vLLM holdout on the corrected high-FR MMLU-Pro question pool. This run is not folded into the sealed N = 14 N{=}14 headline table, the sealed pre-A6 vintage, or any pre-registered rank test; it separates the earlier D5 question-pool exclusion from the substantive screen/collapse pattern. The paired slice is complete: probe α tot = 0.6767 \alpha_{\text{tot}}{=}0.6767 over 1,800 1{,}800 alpha rows ( 200 200 questions × \times 3 3 conditions × \times 3 3 agents), matched to the same 200 200 debated questions with no duplicate question rows. In those debates, initial-majority accuracy improves from 36.5 % 36.5\% to 52.0 % 52.0\% , with 8 / 73 8/73 at-risk initial-correct majorities collapsing ( 10.96 % 10.96\% ) and 39 / 127 39/127 initially-wrong majorities corrected ( 30.71 % 30.71\% ). blocks.en: The cascade calculation is only a directional sanity check for why an adversarial revisability measure might align with early majority failure. In a toy three-agent MCQ panel, condition on the initial majority being correct and suppose each agent independently abandons the correct answer with probability α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} . A wrong Round 1 1 majority then requires at least two agents to abandon the correct answer and coordinate on a wrong option, so a loose upper envelope is Pr ⁡ ( M ( 1 ) ≠ C ) ≤ 3 ​ α adv 2 − 2 ​ α adv 3 \Pr(M^{(1)}{\neq}C)\leq 3\alpha_{\text{adv}}^{2}-2\alpha_{\text{adv}}^{3} , monotone in α adv \alpha_{\text{adv}} on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Adding the observed Round 1 1 majority state to pre-debate features can only improve an ideal Bayes score if Round 1 1 carries information about the final collapse label. These statements are not used for inference; they only explain why the empirical Round 1 1 AUC lift is directionally unsurprising.

blocks.en: Real LLM debate violates the toy calculation in the important ways. Agents share prompts and question context, so their revisions are correlated rather than independent. Question difficulty dominates model-level variance in the crossed-effects fit ( σ question = 1.44 ≫ σ model = 0.71 \sigma_{\text{question}}{=}1.44\,{\gg}\,\sigma_{\text{model}}{=}0.71 ; Table 32 ). The wrong-answer coincidence factor is not uniform because a plausible but wrong argument can steer multiple agents to the same distractor. Most importantly for policy, Round 1 1 is not sufficient: 18.6 % 18.6\% of collapses first appear in Round 2 2 and 22.5 % 22.5\% in Round 3 3 , while some debates later correct a Round 1 1 wrong majority. The calculation is therefore a consistency story, not a theoretical contribution or an empirical bound.

Among the two deployable candidates (Shielded and ACC), ACC was selected on pooled development splits (200 questions/model for Haiku and Phi-4-mini), then evaluated without retuning on fresh 800-question held-out test sets for each model.

blocks.en: The held-out outcome is negative. On the original 800-question test, Phi-4-mini showed a modest positive trend ( + 1.25 +1.25 pp accuracy, − 1.12 -1.12 pp collapse relative to Standard), but neither paired McNemar test was significant ( p = 0.485 p=0.485 for accuracy, p = 0.336 p=0.336 for collapse). To test whether this was a real effect, we ran a powered replication on 1,500 completely fresh questions (disjoint from both the development and original test sets). The positive trend did not replicate: ACC reduces accuracy by 1.93pp and increases collapse by 0.40pp ( p = 0.106 p=0.106 for accuracy, p = 0.656 p=0.656 for collapse). On Haiku, neither Shielded nor ACC beats Standard debate ( p = 0.188 p=0.188 for accuracy, p = 1.000 p=1.000 for collapse). In a smaller reviewer-requested zero-retune transfer check on Qwen3-4B (50 development questions, 300 held-out test questions), ACC is also null ( p = 0.743 p=0.743 for accuracy, p = 1.000 p=1.000 for collapse). We therefore interpret the deployable intervention evidence as proof-of-concept on the development set only: the frozen policy does not transfer reliably to fresh held-out questions.
blocks.zh: 搁置的结果是消极的。 在最初的800-问题测试上,Phi-4-mini表现出了适度的正向趋势(+1.25+1.25pp精度,−1.12-1.12pp相对于标准崩溃),但两个配对的麦克内马尔测试都不显著(p=0.485p=0.485,p=0.336p=0.336)。 为了检验这是否是真正的效果,我们在1500个完全新鲜的问题(与开发组和原测试组脱节)上进行了有动力的复制. 积极趋势没有复制:ACC将精度降低1.93pp,增加坍塌0.40pp(p=0.106p=0.106,p=0.656p=0.656). Haiku上,Shielded和ACC都没有击败标准辩论(准确性为p=0.188 p=0.188,崩溃性为p=1.000 p=1.000). 在一次较小的审查者要求的Qwen3-4B(50个发展问题,300个搁置测试问题)零调试中,ACC也是无效的(准确性为p = 0.743 p = 0.743,崩溃性为p = 1.000 p = 1.000). 因此,我们把可部署的干预证据解释为对整套发展概念的证明:冻结政策不能可靠地转移到新的搁置问题。

blocks.en: E.7 Correction-Preserving Policy Replay
blocks.zh: E.7 校正保留政策重放

blocks.en: To test whether a simpler within-trace R1 gate can preserve corrections, we replay saved debate traces by returning the initial majority whenever a policy fires. On the seven-source primary cohort ( 1,255 1{,}255 usable debates), always freezing prevents 94 94 collapses but loses 124 124 corrections ( − 2.39 -2.39 pp). The intuitive R1-majority-changed rule gates 23.2 % 23.2\% of debates and is still net-negative: 56 56 collapses prevented, 69 69 corrections lost, − 1.04 -1.04 pp accuracy change. Strict leave-one-model-out learned R1 stumps are worse ( − 2.31 -2.31 pp, bootstrap CI [ − 3.21 , − 1.44 ] [-3.21,-1.44] pp), preventing only 2 2 collapses while losing 31 31 corrections in held-out replay. We therefore treat R1 as a diagnostic substrate, not a standalone deployable gate. Source artifact: correction_preserving_policy_replay.json .
blocks.zh: 为了检验一个更简单的追踪R1门能否保存校正,我们通过在政策大火发生时归还最初多数来重放节省的辩论痕迹。 在7个来源的初级辩论组(1,255 1{,}255次可用辩论)上,总是冻结,防止94 94次倒塌,但损失124 124次更正(-2.39-2.39页)。 直观的R1-多数改变规则的门23.2%的争论,而且仍然是净负数:56个56个倒闭,69个69个修正丢失,1.04-1.04页的准确性变化。 严格放行一号模式的学习到的R1立木更糟糕(-2.31-2.31页,靴子圈 CI [-3.21,-1.44] [-3.21,-1.44] pp),只防止了2次倒塌,同时在停放回放中损失了31次更正. 因此,我们将R1视为诊断性底物,而不是一个独立的可部署大门。 源头文物:校正_保定_政策_重播. json.

With τ \tau and freeze-mode selected on training models only (no test-label leakage), the LOMO-frozen policy is pooled net-negative ( − 1.21 -1.21 pp): only Llama-3.1-8B’s 95% bootstrap CI on Δ \Delta acc crosses zero, and the three other models are significantly harmed. blocks.en: E.9 Cheap Baselines: DisagreementGate and DRS
blocks.zh: 联合国 廉价基线: 分歧与 DRS

blocks.en: To address whether the probe signal contributes anything beyond simpler agreement / confidence signals, we evaluate two cheap baselines on the same development sets used in Table 35 : • DisagreementGate : freeze the initial majority whenever the three agents do not initially agree; otherwise return the standard debate outcome. • Dynamic Round Selection (DRS) : use panel-mean flip rate to decide whether to debate at all; skip debate (return initial majority) iff initial panel is unanimous AND mean revisability > 0.5 >0.5 ; otherwise return the standard debate outcome. On Haiku (200 development questions), DisagreementGate yields 73.0 % 73.0\% accuracy / 7.0 % 7.0\% collapse and DRS yields 74.5 % / 5.0 % 74.5\%/5.0\% , both worse than ACC’s 78.0 % / 1.5 % 78.0\%/1.5\% . On Phi-4-mini, DisagreementGate is 55.7 / 2.6 55.7/2.6 , DRS is 58.3 / 7.3 58.3/7.3 , and ACC is 59.9 / 4.7 59.9/4.7 . On GPT-4o-mini, where collapse is already rare ( 2.0 % 2.0\% ), all four candidates (Standard, Shielded, ACC, DRS) sit within ± 1.5 \pm 1.5 pp of each other and none robustly beats Standard. We read these results as: the probe signal carries information that simple disagreement / confidence gating does not on collapse-prone models, but converting that information into a deployable policy that wins under frozen evaluation remains the open problem documented in Section E.6 and Section E.8 .
blocks.zh: 为了解决探测器信号是否有助于超越更简单的协议/信心信号的问题,我们评价表35中使用的同一套开发软件的两个廉价基线: 分歧 门:只要三个代理人最初不同意,就冻结最初多数;否则就退回标准的辩论结果。 ^ 动态回合选择(DRS):使用面板-正反翻转率来决定是否辩论;跳过辩论(返回初始多数) 如果初始面板是一致的,是平均的可重视性 > 0.5 > 0.5;否则返回标准的辩论结果. 关于Haiku(200个发展问题),分歧 门的收成为73.0% 准确度为73.0% / 7.0% 崩塌度为7.0% , DRS的收成为74.5% / 5.0% 74.5% / 5.0% , 两者都比ACC的78.0% / 1.5% 78.0% / 1.5% 。 在Phi-4-mini上,分歧是55.7 / 2.6 55.7/2.6, DRS是58.3/ 7.3 58.3/7.3, ACC是59.9/ 4.7 59.9/4.7。 在GPT-4o-mini上,坍塌现象已经很少(2.0 % 2.0\%),所有四个候选者(标准,盾牌,ACC,DSS)都在±1.5\pm 1.5pp之间坐在一起,没有一个强力击败标准. 我们读到这些结果是:探测信号载有的信息是,简单的分歧/信心定位并不是对易坍塌模型的,而是将这一信息转化为在冻结评价下获胜的可部署政策,这仍然是E.6节和E.8节记录的公开问题。
